items.note: The exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X) with restored scratch wires and the forward/inverse/forward composition match Lemma lem:scalar-motifs (728-765). The derivation gives only the bit-case central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2. The complex coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 (756-758) and the neighbour and wire counts W_b, W_c (767-783) are missing, and the net-change formula (JV+RG)x appears only in the motivation.

It states the frame on each gate and terminal, the fact that a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, and the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, as at 804-825. It is an infer step with a quote and no method, so it is stated, not derived.

These items are correct: the forms I-J/9 over Q and the dot product over F_2, comparable labels, decreases only on central wires 3->4 losing h, the telescoping to Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, orthonormal residual bases, and L/N=100/539 and 101/539. The essential construction is never given: the stage labels A⊗<t>⊗Q and B=P^perp (899-937), the gate-label table eq:motif-labels and the residual table (1021-1043). S1.1.3.2 only restates the lemma.

These items follow the proof at 1156-1171: endpoint difference I_m on every input role, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, rank of P_V-P_U equal to dim V-dim U, the extra rank from the 2P_{U_a} source edge, the deficit N-2L_b, and the computation P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m. The frames Phi_M and the shear H<-H+D appear in S1.2.1.3b.

It follows the paper's route: weight additivity mod 4, odd weight of norm-one vectors, Hadamard conjugation of the character to X_v, the count s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c with deficit 2N-2L_c, the 27 inverse factors turned into C by Z-conjugation, and C^{⊗m} on every role after undoing the exchange. The method's 'phase frames i^{wt(P_U x)}' leaves out the H^{⊗m} conjugation in the definition at 1193, but S1.1.5.2 restores it.

It correctly states s_b/W_b<m^tau and s_c/W_c<m^sigma with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, together with L/N<1/2 and the strict deficits. The explicit eta_b and eta_c and the log m<20 step (1332-1338) are absent; only the quote carries the bound 20·2^{-50}.

The steps use controlled shifts and row splitting at linear cost: the triangular updates in O(V) and the O(V) cyclic rotation. Neither lemma is stated, and no step gives its content, such as the offset preparable in b^{O(1)} or the list of elementary operations.

Both statements are correct: the lower-lower factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, and the shear at a cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V). The cost proof follows 1425-1446. The elimination proof of the factorization (1375-1391) is only quoted, and the choice of the fixed prime q avoiding the denominators of the table (1413-1423) is absent.

It reproduces the proof at 1491-1615: the cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on each edge by recursive interchanges, H<-H+D on every row, the three-update interchange, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) solved by the two-case geometric sum, and the parking-stack schedule at O(V) per node.

It follows 1649-1734: the top rho digits form a row field q^{2rho}>=W^k, zero rows pad to a multiple of W^k, the remaining width is cut in base m and summed geometrically, and binary ranges are padded to [q^e]. The unequal-width remark (1740-1762) is not covered, but it lies outside the lemma.

It follows the paper: conjugation by P_M as in eq:phase-edge-coordinate, one child (C^eps)^{⊗f} per slot, the inverse child through (-i)^f Z C Z, at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, exactly s_c children on e/m axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. The summary in S1.3.1 speaks loosely of 's_c residual-basis slots' (see errors).

It reproduces the eight parity-conditioned additions, the packed cyclic shifts, the guard interval with 20 excluded values, delta_bad=80(f-1)2^{-K} by the union bound, T_0S_0^{-1} permuting B, swaps plus O(V) rotations, extraction with a radix sort and reinsertion, the last bit by an elementary operation, and the cost O(V((eK)^tau+1)) for a change of basis.

It follows 2286-2445: s calls at an internal node with overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0 row chunks, padding to W^{k_0}, rows dealt by u=Wg+w, a LIFO parking stack, and F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) unrolled into an internal part O(e^lambda) and leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), summed over base-m pieces to O(d^{lambda'}).

It states the layer H_0 on D<=d chunks in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with one truncation error below sqrt2·2^{-p}. Both the guard width (E=64(W+m+1)^3, A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, A<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p)) and the proof's assembly (2686-2757) match the paper.

It covers character cancellation by the shift k->k+t/2^{v+1}, decimation in frequency into bit-reversed order, the reversed procedure giving F^+B^{-1}, the layout L by prefix moves and Dq-1 chunk exchanges, error sqrt2·l·2^{-p}, and cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^{lambda'}]), all as in the paper.

It covers evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, centered-residue extraction (|h_j|<B_0/2), the negacyclic wrap with |H_j|<=r2^{2p}, truncation by a shift of p+l, and cost O(rp log(rp)), as in 3233-3367.
It gives the retained LB order, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the normalization through F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g), the error M(3delta+eta)=sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, and the stated cost, as in the proof at 3414-3494.

It covers P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, the quoted Harvey-van der Hoeven facts, A=S' and B_0=D'J'C, the left inverse DN^{-1}C, errors 16p and 4+3p^2/4 with time O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha), the permutations kept unsorted, the tensor form, and the costs of lines and axis exposure, all matching 3576-3897.

The cancellation (u*v)/S^2 is derived as in the paper: F^+R=R^{-1}F^+, then commutation with pointwise products, then the convolution rule. The chirp identity QF_t u = conj(a)·(a*(conj(a)·u))/T is only asserted (S3.1.3 is an infer step). The periodicity of a and the coefficient computation exp(2pi i sum s_i j_i k_i/t_i) at 3939-3951 are absent.

It lists the fixed exponents; b, p=6b, d, K, T and the t_i; the comparison constants; primes in ((1-2eta)t_i,(1-eta)t_i] from the Rosser-Schoenfeld count; T/2<S<T by Bernoulli; alpha^4 theta_i>p; the n^{o(1)} search; and no wraparound with c_j<2^{3b}. Everything matches the paper. The values of alpha and gamma (4091-4101) are not stated.

It covers the isomorphism x->prod x_i^{mu_i}, the triangular digit formula, updates in order d..1 from the original controls, preservation of the valid set, and cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)), as in the paper.

It covers the well-definedness (zeta y)^r=1, the diagonal isomorphism, the wrap factor zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T. The twist errors below 4 enter through S4.3.

It covers the chirp transform, the source transform with exact counterpart 2^gamma B_0 QF_t A=RF_s and its conjugate, digits scaled by 2^{-b-2}, Phi, the two transforms, the pointwise product, F^+, the scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, and carries, with the two occurrences of S explained as at 4536-4541.

The error chain matches 4546-4806: transform error <L, the .7/.701 disk margin, complex convolution <6TL, chirp <8TL, E_s=9·2^gamma TL, z error (2E_s+2), the opposite transform (3E_s+2), E_w<28·2^gamma T^2L, the final 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding, and carries. E_ring<5TL is not displayed but is subsumed in S4.3.
It covers V=Tp, the seven margins with min g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, each row's justification, setup o(Tp), exceptional sorting o(V), log p powers absorbed, and the schoolbook cutoff, as in the paper.
S0 relies on 'nlogn-conjecture', and its motivation cites the Theta(n log n) scanning cost. No step states the eventual lower bound or its negation by liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0.

errors.says: C^{⊗e} is computed by applying (C^eps)^{⊗f} 'on each of s_c residual-basis slots of f chunks'.
errors.paper: A group has only m slots. Each edge applies one child per vector of its own residual basis, rho_edge of them, on slots 1..rho_edge after conjugation by P_M (1878-1882). s_c is the total number of child calls over the whole network invocation (1904-1906), not a number of slots.
The frame is C_U = H^{⊗m} diag_x(i^{q_U(x)}) H^{⊗m}, conjugated by Hadamard matrices (1193). The diagonal phase alone is the frame only in the Hadamard basis. S1.1.5.2 supplies the conjugation.

errors.says: Each rotation moves its target after its controls 'using one chunk swap of cost O(VL^tau)'.
errors.paper: The target is moved to the rightmost position if necessary, and the swap is undone after the rotation, for at most sixteen swaps for the eight rotations (2117-2155).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from the two finite networks (frames, labels, rank budget, s<Wm, tau=1-2^{-50}) through the recursive interchange and the butterfly layer to the synthetic transforms, resampling, chirp, CRT, exact recovery and the cost table, ending at O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It thins out at the base: the label construction is asserted by quoting Lemma lem:motif-residuals instead of being built, the complex scalar coefficient and the network parameters (h=100, N, m=h^3, wire counts) are missing, and the factorization lemma and the chirp identity are only quoted. The concluding step that the bound refutes the n log n conjecture is absent.

steps.note: The exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X) restoring every scratch wire is stated. The defining parameters are absent: h=100, data pairs X_a,Y_a indexed by triples a in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 (653-660). N and m appear only as unnamed symbols, so the verdict is conservative.
It states a common invertible frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, the network implementing D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the conclusion that only endpoint frames matter while edges change frame.

It states nondegenerate subspace labels in an m-dimensional space built from tensored triple indicators, every edge joining comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges being the central wires 3->4, each losing h. The explicit label table is not given.
It states that P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate U⊂V, and that the N negative source projections each add one rank: the first edge matrix 2P_{U_a} has rank one.
It states the sum of absolute changes Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
It states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0), and hence s<Wm.
It states the endpoint difference I_m on every input role, P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, and that with shear frames the network gives H<-H+D on every row, including scratch rows.
It states the factorization E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, the shear at a cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls in all at a node.
It states children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau). The bound eta>20·2^{-50} appears only in the quote, and log m<20 is not given.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost entirely: frames, nested labels with losses only on the central returns, rank equal to dimension change plus N source ranks, the budget s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity giving the shear, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence to O(e^tau) with tau=1-2^{-50}. Only the fixed network's parameters are missing (h=100, triple-indexed banks, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3), and the label construction itself is asserted rather than built.
